content:
QuotaFactory is a B2B sales acceleration platform and services company. It helps companies to scale sales development operations. They use a mix of software, data, and outsourced SDR execution. It helps businesses improve outbound prospecting and build predictable sales pipelines.

​It has a proprietary Sales Development Operating System and helps SDR teams focus on potential leads, qualification, and appointment generation.

How QuotaFactory Works?

  2. Prospect Data Acquisition- They build and clean potential lead databases depending on their client's ICPs. It includes contact acquisition, data verification, email validation, and direct dial enrichment.
  3. SDR Staffing and Executive- The agency provides trained outsourced SDRs to run outbound campaigns. It involves holding, email outreach, and lead qualification.
  4. Lead Qualification and Handoff- QuotaFactory integrates strict qualification criteria built into the workflow. Thus, only the leads matching pre-defined ICP standards are handed over to account executives.

Why QuotaFactory Stands Out?

  • PRM instead of Traditional CRM- Emphasizes on potential workflows instead of deal management workflows, thus more useful for SDR teams.
  • Build-and-Transfer Model- Helps businesses to build sales systems and can own the systems later.
  • SDR-focused workflow design- Made for high-volume outbound sales activity. This reduces CRM complexity for SDRs.
  • Integrated Sales Stack- Uses data, dialers, email sequencing, tracking and reporting under one ecosystem.

Key Services

  • Custom Sales Development System- Builds a structured outbound sales framework for every client.
  • Prospect Data Acquisition- Makes special databases to target only potential qualified leads for outbound campaigns.
  • SDR outsourcing- Give dedicated SDR teams for pipeline generation.
  • Sales Playbook Development- Agency builds custom messaging and qualification frameworks.
  • Build-and-Transfer Sales Incubation- Helps businesses start and transition outbound sales internally.

Advanced Capabilities

  • Algorithmic Lead Qualification- QuotaFactory uses hardcoded qualification logic to remove subjectivity.
  • Automated Call Planning- They list daily tasks and call lists automatically based on priority.
  • Integrated Power Dialing- They reduce wasted dialing time, thereby increasing live conversations.
  • Data Rich Integration: It provides integration with sales intelligence tools like ZoomInfo and InsideView.
  • SDR Workflow Optimization: Their SDR focuses on active probable customers rather than CRM monitoring.

Who Should Work with QuotaFactory?

  • High-growth B2B companies that want outbound sales quickly.
  • Companies creating internal SDR teams that want external help at the early stages.
  • Businesses have complex sales cycles.
  • Teams Struggling with CRM Workflows.

Best-Fit Industries

  • SaaS
  • B2B Services
  • Enterprise Technology
  • Industrial, financial, and professional services

Key Use Cases

  • To launch new outbound channels: Ideal for businesses that want to set up an outbound sales system from the beginning.
  • Training Internal SDR Teams: It acts as the temporary external SDR team that firms set up in-house.
  • Encourages Account-based Selling: Improve ICP alignment between marketing and sales.
  • Increases SDR Productivity: Replaces CRM workflows with a result-based SDR prospecting system.
  • Scaling Pipeline Generation: Increases outbound activity and qualified meetings.

Pros

  • Better control over lead generation.
  • Build and transfer model for clients reduces long-term agency lock-in.
  • Integrated sales stack in a single platform.

Considerations

  • Needs future internal hiring for moving in-house.
